Class VelocityUpdateParameter

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<String>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.CategoricalParameter
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.VelocityUpdateParameter
public class VelocityUpdateParameter extends CategoricalParameter
A categorical parameter representing different velocity update strategies for Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). This parameter allows selecting and configuring various velocity update mechanisms used in PSO algorithms.

The available velocity update strategies are:

  • defaultVelocityUpdate: Standard velocity update with cognitive and social components
  • constrainedVelocityUpdate: Velocity update that handles constrained optimization problems
  • SPSO2011VelocityUpdate: Velocity update following the Standard PSO 2011 specifications

Each strategy requires specific parameters (c1Min, c1Max, c2Min, c2Max) that control the cognitive and social components of the velocity update.

  • Method Details

    • getVelocityUpdate

      public org.uma.jmetal.component.catalogue.pso.velocityupdate.VelocityUpdate getVelocityUpdate()
      Creates and returns a VelocityUpdate instance based on the current parameter value. The specific implementation is determined by the current value of this parameter.

      Required sub-parameters for each strategy:

      • For all strategies: c1Min, c1Max, c2Min, c2Max (double values)
      • For constrainedVelocityUpdate and SPSO2011VelocityUpdate: problem (DoubleProblem)
      Returns:
      A configured VelocityUpdate implementation based on the current parameter value
      Throws:
      org.uma.jmetal.util.errorchecking.JMetalException - if the current value does not match any known velocity update strategy
      ClassCastException - if any required sub-parameter has an incorrect type
      NullPointerException - if any required sub-parameter is not found
